buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Not enough to call on freshness; the small lean is to De Reales. Masarova has logged 86 games across 4 matches in 14 days, De Reales only 65 across 3.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to De Reales on motivation and pressure. De Reales is on the way up (+108 Elo over 90 days) while Masarova has been sliding (-28). Deciding-set record under pressure: De Reales 73%, Masarova 55%. Offsetting that, Masarova's comeback rate is 32% against 8% for De Reales, which matters if the first set slips away.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Conditions point fairly clearly to De Reales. On Clay, De Reales has won 66% over the past year (35 matches) to Masarova's 52% (27). De Reales has 18 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Masarova only 12, so the adjustment period is shorter.
